Description: 10-1200 mbar, same range as MS5611, different output coding
Notes: v2 NEW - the only part v2 adds. MS5611 is the independent variable for M1 M2 M3 and M4: one sensor, four missions. A DIFFERENT part number rather than a second MS5611 because two identical sensors from one reel share failure modes and calibration errors. Agreement between the two is meaningful evidence; disagreement tells you something real. Also gives a free cross-check dataset.
RH is only meaningful below ~10 km. Above that absolute humidity is ~0 and response time goes to hours. Also detects condensation/icing on descent - a real failure mode.
+/-0.1C matters: the memory retention curve is plotted against this axis.

Cheap thermal map of the board. One near the regulators one near the memory group.
Best gyro noise in class. +/-32g and high ODR give burst and parachute-shock capture for free. Avoid MPU-6050 - obsolete and heavily counterfeited.

v2 CHANGE from MMC5983MA. MMC has better noise but LIS3MDL is an ST part stocked everywhere with drivers in every framework. Its job is spin rate and coarse heading for the M6 antenna-orientation analysis - LIS3MDL is far more accurate than that job needs. Trading unneeded performance for supply certainty on an optional part.

Three CALIBRATED channels. Cheap single-channel UV parts (GUVA-S12SD ML8511 VEML6075) cannot produce a defensible irradiance figure. NEEDS a quartz or PTFE window - ordinary plastic blocks UVB and UVC entirely.
Only galvanic path from the HV module. A fault there cannot reach the MCU. 2mm creepage and a keep-out slot under the body.
Volatile - has a genuine measurable Vdd retention threshold that moves with temperature. The primary M7 subject.
Floating-gate charge retention is strongly temperature dependent. CRITICAL because it is also your backup log if the SD card fails.
Push-push not hinged - better vibration retention. Add a mechanical retainer or tape for flight.
During the V_MEM hold phase the memory may sit at 1.2V while the MCU is at 3.3V. Hi-Z plus series limiting prevents ESD-structure injection and latch-up. Place at the MCU end.
TX current is a step load. Without local isolation the rail dip shows up in M7 data as a false anomaly.
